status.offline: Offline — your edits stay on this device
reload.restored: {name} restored a version of this board. Loading the restored version…
reload.restoredUnknown: A version of this board was restored. Loading the restored version…
reload.replaced: The board content was replaced by someone else. Loading the current version…
reload.access: Your access to this board changed.
reset.epoch: This board was restored or replaced while you were offline. Your local edits could not be merged and were discarded.
reset.discarded: The server rejected a change of yours: {reason} The change was discarded and the board went back to the server's state.
denied.rate: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment.
tooLarge: This change is too large for the server (limit {mb} MB) and was discarded. Use a smaller image.
error.connect: Live editing could not be opened. Your data is still saved on this device.
presence.title: People on this board
follow.paused: Following paused — you moved the view
inUseBy: {name} is using this object. It becomes available when they release the selection.
follow.ledBy: {name} is leading — your view follows theirs
follow.leading_one: You are leading the view of {count} person
follow.leading_other: You are leading the view of {count} people
selectionReleasedIdle: Your selection was released after a while without activity, so other people can use the object.
replay.done_one: {count} change made while offline was sent to the server.
replay.done_other: {count} changes made while offline were sent to the server.
replay.refused_one: {count} object changed while offline was not accepted: {reason} Everything else was sent.
replay.refused_other: {count} objects changed while offline were not accepted: {reason} Everything else was sent.
replay.refusedBoard: A board change made while offline was not accepted: {reason} Everything else was sent.
replay.gone_one: {count} object you changed while offline was deleted by someone else; your change was left out.
replay.gone_other: {count} objects you changed while offline were deleted by someone else; your changes were left out.
replay.boardSettings: Changes to the board order or settings were also left out.
replay.failed: The changes made while offline could not be sent to the server. The board was reset to the server version.
